title: Babes in Toyland
plot: All roads lead to magical, merry Toyland as Mary Contrary and Tom Piper prepare for their wedding. But villainous Barnaby wants Mary for himself, so he kidnaps Tom, setting off a series of comic chases, searches, and double-crosses.
writer: Victor Herbert (operetta), Glen MacDonough (operetta), Ward Kimball (screenplay), Joe Rinaldi (screenplay), Lowell S. Hawley (screenplay), Anna Alice Chapin (libretto)
actors: Ray Bolger, Tommy Sands, Annette Funicello, Ed Wynn
awards: Nominated for 2 Oscars. Another 1 win & 4 nominations.

title: Greyfriars Bobby: The True Story of a Dog
plot: The remarkable veritable story of a terrier named Bobby and the enduring friendship he forges with a tenderhearted shepherd known simply as Old Jock---unbroken even by the kindly old man's death.
actors: Donald Crisp, Laurence Naismith, Alex Mackenzie, Duncan Macrae

title: One Hundred and One Dalmatians
plot: When a litter of Dalmatian puppies are abducted by the minions of Cruella de Vil, the parents must find them before she uses them for a diabolical fashion statement.
director: Clyde Geronimi, Hamilton Luske, Wolfgang Reitherman
actors: Rod Taylor, J. Pat O'Malley, Betty Lou Gerson, Martha Wentworth
awards: Won 1 BAFTA Film Award. Another 2 nominations.

title: The Absent Minded Professor
plot: A college professor invents an anti-gravity substance which a corrupt businessman wants for himself.
actors: Fred MacMurray, Nancy Olson, Keenan Wynn, Tommy Kirk
awards: Nominated for 3 Oscars. Another 1 win & 5 nominations.

title: The Parent Trap
plot: Teenage twin sisters swap places and scheme to reunite their divorced parents.
writer: Erich Kästner (book), David Swift (written for the screen by)
actors: Hayley Mills, Maureen O'Hara, Brian Keith, Charles Ruggles
awards: Nominated for 2 Oscars. Another 2 wins & 6 nominations.
